Container.Name: vivado
Container.Overview: Headless AMD/Xilinx Vivado build environment. The image contains NO Vivado - install it once via the container Console (run-installer.sh) into the mounted /opt/Xilinx folder, then run batch Tcl builds via Console or 'docker exec'. Keep everything on the cache pool; 32 GB RAM recommended. Runs as nobody:users (99:100).
Container.Description: Headless Vivado build environment (no Vivado in the image; installed at runtime into /opt/Xilinx). See docs/UNRAID-DOCKER-UI.md.

Config.Name: Xilinx install (~100GB)
Config.Description: Where Vivado gets installed. Put it on the cache pool.

Config.Name: Installer
Config.Description: Drop AMD's OFFLINE Vivado installer (and install_config.txt) here.
